question: Copy with the canvas: Option Shift Command C is already Copy Look. Where does it go?
context: You chose that Copy leaves a blank canvas out and that holding Option gives the copy WITH the canvas. The first half shipped today. The second half cannot be built as written: a Mac menu only swaps a row under Option when the two rows share a key, and Copy Merged plus Option (Option Shift Command C) is already Copy Look. Tested: with both on that key, the Option row swallows the press and Copy Look stops working.

options.label: A row of its own under Copy Merged
options.summary: Edit shows Copy Merged, then Copy Merged with Background on Control Shift Command C, always visible. Copy Look keeps its keys.
pros: You can see it without knowing a trick
No key anybody uses today moves
cons: Two copy rows side by side in Edit, the clutter your answer B avoided
Control is not the key a Mac user reaches for first
options.mitigation: It sits directly under Copy Merged so the pair reads as one choice, the same choice the Export sheet offers with Include the background.

options.label: Hold Option, and Copy Look moves
options.summary: Exactly your answer B: hold Option in Edit and Copy Merged becomes Copy Merged with Background on Option Shift Command C. Copy Look and Paste Look move to Control Option Command C and V.
pros: Nothing extra in the menu until you hold Option, the ordinary Mac way
The shortcut is Copy Merged plus Option, easy to guess
cons: Copy Look and Paste Look change keys that already shipped
A variant behind Option is easy never to find
options.mitigation: Copy Look and Paste Look stay on the layer right-click menu and in the Layer menu with their new keys printed beside them.

options.label: Leave the white version to Export
options.summary: Copy always leaves a blank canvas out and there is no copy with it. To hand over the icon on its white, export a PNG with Include the background ticked.
pros: One copy, nothing new to learn
cons: A wireframe drawn on white and pasted into a dark chat loses its backing, with no quick way back
Costs a save and a file each time
options.mitigation: The Export sheet already shows the canvas colour and the checkbox, so the way back is visible there.
